verdicts.why: The show presents the echo as real: Chafa and the ancestors watch over their descendants, and Maya channels them, Chafa included, to defeat Kingpin, so Chafa's involvement has huge consequences for Maya and the rules do not clearly drop it.

Chafa's echo reaches Tuklo and gives her the strength to save her father's Lighthorsemen in Echo#3; the show treats the ancestral echo as a real power, a huge-consequence tie the rules do not clearly drop.
N'Jobu dies years before Shuri is born and they never meet, not even in the ancestral plane; a blood tie never met, and anything that reaches her runs through Erik, who keeps his own tie.

They never meet, and Edwin does nothing to shape J.A.R.V.I.S. himself; Tony models the AI and its Mindspace avatar on him. Whether being the human template of an AI's whole persona counts as huge consequences or only as knowing about him is not something the rules settle.

value.text: Veb is one of the Freedom Fighters resisting Kang's rule. Kang's Quantumnauts capture and imprison him, and he fights in the uprising against Kang at Chronopolis.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A Freedom Fighter who rises up against Kang.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The conqueror whose Quantumnauts imprison Veb and the rebels.

verdicts.why: The wiped-out species backstory comes only from an interview, not the film; on screen Veb's group is captured by Kang's Quantumnauts and M.O.D.O.K. and he fights Kang's forces at Chronopolis. The tie stays as an enemy one.
Lowak is among the ancestral echoes that give Chula the strength to survive Taloa's birth; the show treats the echo as a real force with huge consequences, so the rules do not clearly drop the tie.
The Marvel wiki's page for this Peter says he tells Miles he must accept the truth to keep the Multiverse safe and then joins the Society's chase to stop him going home, so the text holds.

Maya channels her ancestors, Lowak included, to give herself, Bonnie and Chula the strength to defeat Kingpin; the echo is a real power in the show with huge consequences, so the tie is not clearly dropped.

They never meet; Walker only admires Steve and takes up the shield Steve passed to Sam. Whether inheriting Steve's mantle counts as huge consequences from Steve's involvement, or only knowing about a legend, the rules do not settle.
Laufey never appears in Eternals; Gilgamesh only tells of fighting his army at Tonsberg, a told shared battle with no dealing between them.

value.text: Ward hunts Petra Larsen and Jakob Nystrom's Paganists for the Berserker Staff. At the church in Ireland, after he beats Nystrom and their followers, Petra tries to take the staff from him, and May stops her.

verdicts.why: The text describes only Ward and Nystrom. In The Well, Ward's team pursues Larsen and Nystrom, and after Ward collapses Larsen moves to grab the staff before May defeats her, so the tie stays with a text about the two of them.
Erik dies in Black Panther before Toussaint is born and they never meet; a blood tie never met, with no consequence of Erik's for Toussaint shown.

Sitwell helps devise the patsy plan that makes Ross refuse the Council's request, so Blonsky stays imprisoned and off the Avengers; that involvement has huge consequences for Blonsky, which the exception covers.

Tuklo's echo gives Maya strength against the cartel, and Maya channels her with the other ancestors to defeat Kingpin; the show treats the echo as real, a huge-consequence tie the rules do not clearly drop.
Wenwu only tells a story about an unnamed American terrorist who borrowed his legend; Killian is long dead, they never deal with each other, and his dealings over the hoax are with Trevor.
The real Pietro dies in Age of Ultron before Billy exists; the 'Pietro' who spends time with the twins in WandaVision is Ralph Bohner under Agatha's control, so this is a blood tie never met.
Howard dies in 1991 and Morgan is born after the Blip; they never share a scene and nothing on screen shows them dealing with each other, a blood tie never met.

Coulson arranges the sabotage of the Council's request and reports that Blonsky stays in his cage, which keeps Blonsky imprisoned and off the Avengers; that is involvement with huge consequences for Blonsky.

value.text: The zombie Thor joins Wanda's horde in Paris and kills Sara and the London Master, Rintrah's fellow sorcerers, as they defend Banner. Rintrah falls to the horde in the same battle.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A Kamar-Taj sorcerer whose companions he kills.

verdicts.why: The text never mentions Rintrah, and Thor's card says he cuts Rintrah down; in Marvel Zombies#4 Thor kills Sara and the London Master while Rintrah dies to the horde in the same Paris battle.
Chafa's echo gives Chula the strength to deliver Taloa and survive; the show treats the ancestral echo as a real force with huge consequences, so the rules do not clearly drop the tie.

Thor never appears, but Lorelei, an Asgardian prisoner of Odin's, speaks with apparent personal knowledge of how Thor sees Sif, which may imply they know each other; nothing on screen settles it either way, so the tie stays pending the owner.

In The Well, Ward fights and defeats Nystrom, while May takes the staff afterward and defeats Larsen and another Paganist; May and Nystrom never deal with each other, so it is a shared battle with separate actions.
